_comment: Workflow fragment: query (existing, provided by engineer) -> newVariable constant-holder (status) -> merge (build update body) -> updateChangeRequest adapter task -> error handler. Task IDs are hex-only per platform requirement. Field/app names for the adapter task are taken verbatim from helpers/assets/vendor-servicenow.json's real 'Update Change Request' workflow (task id 2ad1 in that asset) as the closest production reference for a ServiceNow update call.

b2c3._comment: EXISTING TASK, per engineer's description. Shown here only for context/wiring reference - do not overwrite the engineer's current query task unless the query path needs correction.
b2c3.name: query
b2c3.description: Extracts the changeId from the ServiceNow createChangeRequest adapter response

c9a1._comment: NEW - constant-holder for the static status value. Per skill gotcha: task:"static" reference objects (used directly inside merge's data_to_merge) resolve to null at runtime on a freshly API-created/PUT workflow until the workflow is opened and saved once in Automation Studio. newVariable's own incoming.value literal does NOT have this problem - it resolves correctly immediately after API create. So the static status value is parked here and pulled into the merge task by task-reference instead of by task:"static".
c9a1.name: newVariable
c9a1.description: Holds the static status value used when building the change request update payload

e1a1._comment: NEW - the merge task requested. Builds the update request body object from (1) the changeId set by the query task's outgoing (job variable, pulled with {task:"job", variable:"changeId"}) and (2) the static status value held by c9a1 (pulled with {task:"c9a1", variable:"value"} instead of {task:"static", variable:...} to avoid the null-until-Studio-save gotcha). Exactly 2 items - satisfies merge's 'minimum 2 items' requirement.
e1a1.name: merge
e1a1.description: Builds the changeId + status payload for the ServiceNow update call

f4d2._comment: NEW - the adapter update call consuming the merge output. Field names (app, locationType, displayName, adapter_id job var naming convention 'adapterId') taken from the real production 'Update Change Request' workflow in helpers/assets/vendor-servicenow.json (task 2ad1). In that real asset, changeId is actually a SEPARATE top-level incoming field (not inside body) - see note in the transcript/answer below about confirming this against the target adapter's actual schema before wiring 'changeId' only inside the merged body.
f4d2.name: updateChangeRequest
f4d2.description: Updates the ServiceNow change request with the new status

ef01._comment: NEW - shared error handler. Needed because JSON cannot have duplicate keys, so success and error can't both route directly to workflow_end from the same task.
ef01.name: newVariable
ef01.description: Marks the update as failed for downstream/parent inspection
